Hi Elena —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary goal: reduce clinician documentation time by ~40% using an assistant that drafts structured notes and surfaces relevant guidelines.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-covered PHI, on-prem data routing for some workloads, and strict retention rules (12 months).
- Success metric you mentioned: 30% reduction in documentation time on pilot cohort + no material regression in accuracy vs. current templates.

Recommended next step: technical deep-dive + evaluation kickoff where we align the trial charter, success criteria, and a prompt set for initial evals. I attached a draft trial charter (Redwood-trial-charter-v0.3.pdf) and a small sample prompt pack (prompt-set-sample.csv) to jumpstart the conversation.

Proposed 60–90 minute deep-dive slots (PT):
- Wed 2028-03-29: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu 2028-03-30: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30

If those don’t work, please share two windows that fit your team. For the deep-dive we’ll include:
- Solutions engineer (prompt and deployment plan) — Priyom Das
- Account exec (commercials & rollout) — Karthik Iyer

Please confirm which slot you prefer and any additional stakeholders to loop in (procurement, security).

Thanks,

Agenda (60–75 minutes):
1) 10–15m introductions + objectives and success criteria (you to confirm clinical ops lead & IT)
2) 20–25m technical deep-dive (architecture, VPC options, data flow for PHI) — Priyom
3) 15–20m trial charter review (milestones, cohort, metrics) — Laura
4) 10–15m next steps: mutual action plan, procurement timeline, security artifacts

Quick answers to your asks:
- VPC-only path: yes — Redwood Private can be configured with a customer VPC for the PHI subset; we’ll map the flow during the deep-dive and note any on-prem considerations.
- SOC2 / security artifacts: we’ll include a copy of our SOC 2 Type II summary, encryption/fips notes, and a network diagram in the calendar invite. If IT needs deeper artifacts we can request an NDA and provide a secure share.

I’m attaching the same draft charter with a short change log and a sample prompt pack to review ahead of the call. If you want us to tailor the prompt set to your EHR snippets, send a small anonymized sample and Priyom can prepare a richer prompt pack for the session.
